scope: COMMON V2.3 legacy finding revalidation for DRCOM23-001

pdf.visual_note: Page 32 visibly presents section 2.52 StopInformationRequest. The table contains ArrivalExpected 0:1 and DepartureExpected 0:1, each typed IBIS-IP.dateTime. The same table also visibly retains StopName 0:1, separating the new absent-element facet from the already-established StopName cardinality finding.

authority.authority_note: The official VDV-301-2.3 Common schema explicitly includes Enumerations V2.2. Integration-branch bytes match this exact official family; no later enumeration substitution or latest-wins rule is permitted.

finding.claim: COMMON V2.3 PDF documents ArrivalExpected and DepartureExpected as optional members of StopInformationRequest while the exact official V2.3 StopInformationRequestStructure contains neither element.
finding.visual_result: Rendered page 32 visibly confirms ArrivalExpected 0:1 and DepartureExpected 0:1 in StopInformationRequest.
finding.xsd_result: Exact Common V2.3 contains neither element in StopInformationRequestStructure, while both are present as optional IBIS-IP.dateTime fields in StopInformationStructure.
finding.validation_behavior: material; validators and generated request models must not accept or expose ArrivalExpected/DepartureExpected in StopInformationRequest solely from the PDF table, while the fields remain valid in StopInformation according to the exact V2.3 schema
